events.name: US ISM Manufacturing PMI
events.description: Survey of purchasing managers gauging US factory activity; a timely read on growth and price pressures.

events.name: China Manufacturing PMI
events.description: Monthly survey of Chinese factory conditions; a key gauge of momentum in the world's second-largest economy.

events.name: Australia RBA Interest Rate Decision
events.description: Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate; markets price a likely hike after recent tightening.

events.name: US JOLTS Job Openings
events.description: Count of unfilled US jobs; shows labour demand strength ahead of Friday's payrolls report.

events.name: Eurozone CPI Flash (Y-o-Y)
events.description: Preliminary euro area consumer inflation estimate; central to ECB policy expectations and euro direction.

events.name: US ISM Services PMI
events.description: Survey of US services-sector activity, the largest part of the economy; signals growth and price trends.

events.name: UK BoE Interest Rate Decision
events.description: Bank of England sets Bank Rate with a new Monetary Policy Report; a hike to 4.00% is widely expected.

events.name: US Initial Jobless Claims
events.description: Weekly count of new US unemployment filings; a high-frequency indicator of labour market health.

events.name: US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP)
events.description: Monthly change in US non-farm jobs; the most market-moving gauge of labour strength and Fed policy.

events.name: US Unemployment Rate
events.description: Share of the US labour force without work; a core Fed mandate indicator alongside payrolls.
